decision_rule.account_continuity: each exact YES and NO balance must remain equal mergeable and unchanged and no non-YIELD wallet activity may occur during the selected interval
decision_rule.distribution_selection: for each wallet select the second chronological YIELD row after the conflict snapshot so its preceding daily interval is wholly post-conflict
decision_rule.rate_resolution: each selected payout must map under four-decimal round-down to exactly one frozen candidate annual rate and integer hourly sample count from zero through twenty-four and all three wallets must resolve to the same rate
decision_rule.receipt_reconciliation: each selected YIELD row must reconcile to one successful Polygon pUSD transfer from the exact holding-yield distributor to the exact wallet
decision_rule.unresolved_behavior: any balance change pagination ceiling non-daily interval non-YIELD activity receipt mismatch ambiguous rate or cross-wallet disagreement keeps the current operating rate unqualified

request_contract.pagination: one_limit_500_offset_0_response_per_exact_wallet and fail closed if any response reaches the limit
request_contract.repeat_policy: one use only; existing output journal or raw directory prohibits reuse
